name: Thabo Dlamini
bio:
Thabo's culinary journey began in the vibrant kitchens of Durban, where he honed his skills in traditional South African cuisine. A chance encounter with a motorsport team during a catering event sparked his passion for combining his culinary expertise with the high-octane world of racing. He quickly recognized the crucial role catering plays in team morale and performance, ensuring drivers and crew are well-nourished and focused. 

Thabo approaches catering with meticulous planning and a deep understanding of dietary needs for peak performance. He thrives under pressure, adapting menus to suit diverse tastes and logistical challenges. What sets Thabo apart is his dedication to sourcing local, sustainable ingredients whenever possible, bringing a taste of South Africa to every race weekend and fostering a sense of community within the team.

physical.description: Thabo is a powerfully built man with a friendly smile and a reassuring presence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with recipe ideas and flavor combinations.
Insists on playing upbeat Kwaito music while prepping meals.
Has a knack for remembering everyone's preferred beverage.
